title: Hearing Aid Education and Adaptation System
brief_summary: This RCT will have two arms: A control group that receives the standard of care from audiologists and an experimental group that receives both the standard of care and the at-home use of the TELLYHealth intervention. Subjects in each group will complete questionnaires at enrollment, mid-study and at the end of the study.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Speaks and reads English fluently
* Has mild (25-40 dB) to severe (70-95 dB) monaural sensorineural hearing loss
* Will be fitted with one or two hearing aids at the time of enrollment
* Owns a standard TV
* Has Internet access at home
* Has sufficient corrected vision to watch videos and read text on the TV and mobile device
* No signs of dementia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Lives with person who has enrolled in the study
